"""Derived per-job result status.

This is an index/reference layer, never a second terminal source of truth.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any


READ_CONTRACT_VERSION = "v1"

_CERTIFIED_VALUES = frozenset(
    {
        "CERTIFIED",
        "CERTIFIED_READ_ONLY",
        "CERTIFIED_OPERATIONAL",
        "CERTIFIED_FRONTEND_BUILD",
    }
)


def utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


def _derive_work_completion(
    payload: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    terminal_valid: bool,
    state: str,
) -> str:
    if not terminal_valid:
        if state == "RESULT_ABSENT":
            return "RESULT_ABSENT"
        return str(
            payload.get("work_completion")
            or "INVALID_RESULT_ARTIFACT"
        )

    explicit = payload.get("work_completion")
    if isinstance(explicit, str) and explicit.strip():
        return explicit.strip()

    cert = str(payload.get("certification") or "").strip().upper()
    if cert in _CERTIFIED_VALUES:
        return "COMPLETE"
    if cert == "PENDING_AUDIT_EVIDENCE":
        return "PENDING_CERTIFICATION"
    if cert in {"PENDING_DELIVERABLES", "OBJECTIVE_PENDING"}:
        return cert
    return "NOT_CERTIFIED"


def build_job_status(
    *,
    result_read: Any,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = (
        dict(result_read.payload)
        if isinstance(result_read.payload, dict)
        else {}
    )
    terminal_valid = bool(result_read.terminal_result_valid)
    state = str(result_read.state or "")

    if not terminal_valid:
        if state == "RESULT_ABSENT":
            status_val = "RESULT_ABSENT"
            blockers_val = list(
                payload.get("blockers")
                or ["result_absent:RESULT_ABSENT"]
            )
            reconciliation_val = "RESULT_ABSENT_FAIL_CLOSED"
        else:
            raw_status = str(payload.get("status") or "").strip().upper()
            status_val = (
                raw_status
                if raw_status
                in {
                    "INVALID_RESULT_ARTIFACT",
                    "CONTRADICTORY_RESULT_ARTIFACT",
                }
                else "INVALID_RESULT_ARTIFACT"
            )
            blockers_val = list(
                payload.get("blockers")
                or [f"invalid_result_artifact:{state}"]
            )
            reconciliation_val = str(
                payload.get("reconciliation_status")
                or "INVALID_RESULT_ARTIFACT"
            )

        return {
            "job_id": result_read.job_id,
            "status": status_val,
            "quality_gate": "FAIL",
            "tests": "FAIL",
            "certification": "NOT_CERTIFIED",
            "work_completion": _derive_work_completion(
                payload,
                terminal_valid=False,
                state=state,
            ),
            "percent_complete": 0,
            "blockers": blockers_val,
            "production_touched": bool(
                payload.get("production_touched", False)
            ),
            "worker_mode": payload.get("slot_class") or payload.get("mode"),
            "result_path": result_read.result_path,
            "result_sha": result_read.result_sha256,
            "result_size_bytes": result_read.result_size_bytes,
            "terminal_result_valid": False,
            "result_state": state,
            "reconciliation_status": reconciliation_val,
            "completed_at_utc": payload.get("completed_at_utc"),
            "generated_at_utc": utc_now(),
            "read_contract_version": READ_CONTRACT_VERSION,
        }

    commit_sha = (
        payload.get("commit_sha")
        or payload.get("certified_source_sha")
        or payload.get("development_sha")
        or payload.get("integrated_commit")
    )

    status_dict: dict[str, Any] = {
        "job_id": result_read.job_id,
        "status": payload.get("status"),
        "quality_gate": payload.get("quality_gate"),
        "tests": payload.get("tests"),
        "certification": payload.get("certification"),
        "work_completion": _derive_work_completion(
            payload,
            terminal_valid=True,
            state=state,
        ),
        "percent_complete": payload.get("percent_complete"),
        "blockers": payload.get("blockers"),
        "production_touched": payload.get("production_touched"),
        "worker_mode": payload.get("slot_class") or payload.get("mode"),
        "result_path": result_read.result_path,
        "result_sha": result_read.result_sha256,
        "result_size_bytes": result_read.result_size_bytes,
        "terminal_result_valid": True,
        "result_state": state,
        "completed_at_utc": payload.get("completed_at_utc"),
        "generated_at_utc": utc_now(),
        "read_contract_version": READ_CONTRACT_VERSION,
    }
    if commit_sha:
        status_dict["commit_sha"] = commit_sha

    for optional_key in (
        "certified_source_sha",
        "converged_head",
        "certification_basis",
        "reconciliation_status",
        "published_result_commit",
        "published_result_sha256",
        "attestation_sha256",
    ):
        if payload.get(optional_key) is not None:
            status_dict[optional_key] = payload.get(optional_key)

    return status_dict

"""Service boundary for remote Universal Worker submission and status.

This module is intentionally thin. It does not implement another queue,
publisher, scheduler, Git client, SQL executor or Worker. Submission is
delegated to the existing canonical job factory and gate-chain publisher.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Mapping

from tools.mirror_sync import gate_chain_publisher
from tools.mirror_sync.worker_job_factory import canonicalize_job
from tools.mirror_sync.worker_result_reader import read_canonical_result
from tools.mirror_sync.worker_result_status import build_job_status

from .semantic_capabilities import (
    SemanticCapabilityError,
    resolve_capability,
)


REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
STATE_ROOT = REPO_ROOT / ".git" / "universal-worker-queue"
JOB_ID_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{2,120}$")

_SENSITIVE_KEYS = {
    "password",
    "password_decrypted",
    "secret",
    "secrets",
    "token",
    "credentials",
    "credential",
    "api_key",
    "apikey",
}

_SAFE_RESULT_KEYS = {
    "status",
    "quality_gate",
    "certification",
    "work_completion",
    "certification_basis",
    "certified_source_sha",
    "converged_head",
    "development_sha",
    "reconciliation_status",
    "published_result_commit",
    "published_result_sha256",
    "attestation_sha256",
    "tests",
    "percent_complete",
    "blockers",
    "files_changed",
    "commit_sha",
    "integrated_commit",
    "git_sync_status",
    "production_touched",
    "completed_at_utc",
    "summary_es",
}


class WorkerIngressError(ValueError):
    pass


def _clean(value: Any) -> str:
    return str(value or "").strip()


def _assert_no_sensitive_keys(value: Any, path: str = "request") -> None:
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        for key, nested in value.items():
            normalized = str(key).strip().lower()
            if normalized in _SENSITIVE_KEYS:
                raise WorkerIngressError(f"SENSITIVE_FIELD_FORBIDDEN:{path}.{key}")
            _assert_no_sensitive_keys(nested, f"{path}.{key}")
    elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        for index, nested in enumerate(value):
            _assert_no_sensitive_keys(nested, f"{path}[{index}]")


def _requester_from_authenticated_user(
    current_user: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    project: str,
) -> dict[str, str]:
    email = _clean(current_user.get("email")).lower()
    if not email or "@" not in email:
        raise WorkerIngressError("AUTHENTICATED_REQUESTER_EMAIL_REQUIRED")

    return {
        "email": email,
        "source": "edarsahub-worker-ingress",
        "project": _clean(project) or "EDARSAHUB",
        "chat": "remote-canonical-ingress",
    }


def build_canonical_job(
    request_payload: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    current_user: Mapping[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = dict(request_payload)
    _assert_no_sensitive_keys(payload)

    scheduling = payload.get("scheduling")
    scheduling = dict(scheduling) if isinstance(scheduling, Mapping) else {}

    requester = _requester_from_authenticated_user(
        current_user,
        project=_clean(scheduling.get("project_id")) or "EDARSAHUB",
    )

    raw_job = {
        "job_id": payload.get("job_id"),
        "objective": payload.get("objective"),
        "mode": payload.get("mode"),
        "actions": list(payload.get("actions") or []),
        "checks": list(payload.get("checks") or []),
        "requester": requester,
    }
    if scheduling:
        raw_job["scheduling"] = scheduling

    return canonicalize_job(raw_job)


def submit_job(
    request_payload: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    current_user: Mapping[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Submit only through the existing canonical publisher."""
    canonical_job = build_canonical_job(
        request_payload,
        current_user=current_user,
    )
    result = gate_chain_publisher.submit(canonical_job)
    if not isinstance(result, dict):
        raise WorkerIngressError("CANONICAL_PUBLISHER_INVALID_RESPONSE")

    safe = dict(result)
    safe["job_id"] = _clean(result.get("job_id")) or canonical_job["job_id"]
    safe["production_touched"] = bool(result.get("production_touched", False))
    safe.pop("template", None)
    return safe


def _semantic_job_id(
    request_payload: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    requester_email: str,
) -> str:
    bounded_context = _clean(request_payload.get("bounded_context")).upper()
    capability = _clean(request_payload.get("capability")).upper()
    request_key = _clean(request_payload.get("request_key"))
    stable_payload = {
        "requester": requester_email.lower(),
        "objective": _clean(request_payload.get("objective")),
        "bounded_context": bounded_context,
        "mode": _clean(request_payload.get("mode")).upper(),
        "capability": capability,
        "request_key": request_key,
        "constraints": request_payload.get("constraints") or {},
    }
    digest = hashlib.sha256(
        json.dumps(
            stable_payload,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            sort_keys=True,
            separators=(",", ":"),
        ).encode("utf-8")
    ).hexdigest()[:20].upper()
    prefix = re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9._-]+", "-", bounded_context)[:32] or "EDARSAHUB"
    cap = re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9._-]+", "-", capability)[:32] or "CAPABILITY"
    return f"SEM-{prefix}-{cap}-{digest}"[:121]


def build_semantic_job(
    request_payload: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    current_user: Mapping[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = dict(request_payload)
    _assert_no_sensitive_keys(payload)

    objective = _clean(payload.get("objective"))
    bounded_context = _clean(payload.get("bounded_context")).upper()
    requested_mode = _clean(payload.get("mode")).upper()
    capability_code = _clean(payload.get("capability")).upper()

    if not objective:
        raise WorkerIngressError("OBJECTIVE_REQUIRED")
    if not bounded_context:
        raise WorkerIngressError("BOUNDED_CONTEXT_REQUIRED")

    try:
        capability = resolve_capability(capability_code)
    except SemanticCapabilityError as exc:
        raise WorkerIngressError(str(exc)) from exc

    allowed_modes = tuple(str(mode).upper() for mode in capability.modes)
    if requested_mode not in allowed_modes:
        raise WorkerIngressError("SEMANTIC_CAPABILITY_MODE_MISMATCH")

    try:
        expansion = capability.builder(payload)
    except SemanticCapabilityError as exc:
        raise WorkerIngressError(str(exc)) from exc

    if not isinstance(expansion, dict):
        raise WorkerIngressError("SEMANTIC_CAPABILITY_INVALID_EXPANSION")

    requester = _requester_from_authenticated_user(
        current_user,
        project="EDARSAHUB",
    )

    job_id = _semantic_job_id(
        payload,
        requester_email=requester["email"],
    )

    raw_job = {
        "job_id": job_id,
        "objective": objective,
        "mode": requested_mode,
        "actions": list(expansion.get("actions") or []),
        "checks": list(expansion.get("checks") or []),
        "scheduling": dict(expansion.get("scheduling") or {}),
        "requester": requester,
    }
    return canonicalize_job(raw_job)


def submit_objective(
    request_payload: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    current_user: Mapping[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    canonical_job = build_semantic_job(
        request_payload,
        current_user=current_user,
    )
    result = gate_chain_publisher.submit(canonical_job)
    if not isinstance(result, dict):
        raise WorkerIngressError("CANONICAL_PUBLISHER_INVALID_RESPONSE")

    safe = dict(result)
    safe["job_id"] = _clean(result.get("job_id")) or canonical_job["job_id"]
    safe["production_touched"] = bool(result.get("production_touched", False))
    safe["capability"] = _clean(request_payload.get("capability")).upper()
    safe["bounded_context"] = _clean(request_payload.get("bounded_context")).upper()
    safe.pop("template", None)
    return safe


def _read_json_if_object(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return {}
    return payload if isinstance(payload, dict) else {}


def _safe_terminal_fields(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        key: payload.get(key)
        for key in _SAFE_RESULT_KEYS
        if key in payload
    }


def get_job_status(job_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    value = _clean(job_id)
    if not JOB_ID_RE.fullmatch(value):
        raise WorkerIngressError("JOB_ID_INVALID")

    result_path = STATE_ROOT / "results" / f"{value}.json"
    if result_path.is_file():
        result_read = read_canonical_result(
            result_path,
            expected_job_id=value,
        )
        status = build_job_status(result_read=result_read)
        if result_read.terminal_result_valid and isinstance(
            result_read.payload, dict
        ):
            status.update(_safe_terminal_fields(result_read.payload))
            if not status.get("commit_sha"):
                commit_sha = (
                    result_read.payload.get("certified_source_sha")
                    or result_read.payload.get("development_sha")
                    or result_read.payload.get("integrated_commit")
                )
                if commit_sha:
                    status["commit_sha"] = commit_sha
        status["lifecycle"] = "RESULT"
        return status

    rejected_path = STATE_ROOT / "rejected" / f"{value}.json"
    if rejected_path.is_file():
        payload = _read_json_if_object(rejected_path)
        response: dict[str, Any] = {
            "job_id": value,
            "lifecycle": "REJECTED",
            "status": str(payload.get("status") or "REJECTED"),
            "quality_gate": "FAIL",
            "tests": "FAIL",
            "certification": "NOT_CERTIFIED",
            "work_completion": "REJECTED",
            "percent_complete": 0,
            "blockers": list(payload.get("blockers") or ["job_rejected"]),
            "terminal_result_valid": False,
            "result_state": "RESULT_REJECTED",
            "production_touched": False,
        }
        for key in ("completed_at_utc", "summary_es"):
            if key in payload:
                response[key] = payload[key]
        return response

    published_path = STATE_ROOT / "published" / f"{value}.json"
    done_path = STATE_ROOT / "done" / f"{value}.json"
    if published_path.is_file() or done_path.is_file():
        absent_read = read_canonical_result(
            result_path,
            expected_job_id=value,
        )
        status = build_job_status(result_read=absent_read)
        status["lifecycle"] = "RESULT"
        return status

    non_terminal_dirs = (
        ("PROCESSING", "processing"),
        ("PENDING", "pending"),
        ("DRAFT", "drafts"),
    )

    for lifecycle, directory in non_terminal_dirs:
        path = STATE_ROOT / directory / f"{value}.json"
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        payload = _read_json_if_object(path)
        return {
            "job_id": value,
            "lifecycle": lifecycle,
            "status": lifecycle,
            "certification": "NOT_CERTIFIED",
            "work_completion": lifecycle,
            "percent_complete": 0,
            "terminal_result_valid": False,
            "result_state": "RESULT_NON_TERMINAL",
            "production_touched": False,
            "summary_es": payload.get("summary_es"),
        }

    return {
        "job_id": value,
        "lifecycle": "NOT_FOUND",
        "status": "NOT_FOUND",
        "production_touched": False,
    }

"""Minimal MCP transport for the certified EDARSAHUB semantic ingress."""

from typing import Any

try:
    from mcp.server import MCPServer
except ImportError:  # mcp 1.x (backend-compatible: starlette 0.37)
    from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP as MCPServer
from mcp.server.auth.middleware.auth_context import get_access_token
from mcp.server.auth.provider import TokenVerifier
from mcp.server.auth.settings import AuthSettings
from mcp.server.transport_security import TransportSecuritySettings
from mcp.types import ToolAnnotations
from pydantic import AnyHttpUrl

from .auth import EdarsahubTokenVerifier
from .client import (
    get_job_status as backend_get_job_status,
    submit_objective as backend_submit_objective,
)
from .config import WorkerMcpConfig


_BACKEND_URL: str | None = None


def _bearer_token() -> str:
    access_token = get_access_token()
    if access_token is None or not access_token.token:
        raise PermissionError("MCP_AUTH_REQUIRED")
    return str(access_token.token)


def _backend_url() -> str:
    if not _BACKEND_URL:
        raise RuntimeError("MCP_BACKEND_NOT_CONFIGURED")
    return _BACKEND_URL


def submit_objective_tool(
    objective: str,
    bounded_context: str,
    mode: str,
    capability: str,
    request_key: str | None = None,
    constraints: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Submit one approved semantic objective to the EDARSAHUB Universal Worker."""
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
        "objective": objective,
        "bounded_context": bounded_context,
        "mode": mode,
        "capability": capability,
        "constraints": constraints or {},
    }
    if request_key:
        payload["request_key"] = request_key

    result = backend_submit_objective(
        backend_url=_backend_url(),
        token=_bearer_token(),
        payload=payload,
    )

    return {
        "status": result.get("status"),
        "job_id": result.get("job_id"),
        "capability": result.get("capability"),
        "bounded_context": result.get("bounded_context"),
        "production_touched": bool(
            result.get("production_touched", False)
        ),
    }


def get_job_status_tool(
    job_id: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Read the canonical status of one Universal Worker job."""
    result = backend_get_job_status(
        backend_url=_backend_url(),
        token=_bearer_token(),
        job_id=job_id,
    )
    return {
        "job_id": result.get("job_id"),
        "lifecycle": result.get("lifecycle"),
        "status": result.get("status"),
        "certification": result.get("certification"),
        "work_completion": result.get("work_completion"),
        "certification_basis": result.get("certification_basis"),
        "certified_source_sha": result.get("certified_source_sha"),
        "converged_head": result.get("converged_head"),
        "quality_gate": result.get("quality_gate"),
        "tests": result.get("tests"),
        "percent_complete": result.get("percent_complete"),
        "blockers": result.get("blockers"),
        "files_changed": result.get("files_changed"),
        "commit_sha": result.get("commit_sha"),
        "git_sync_status": result.get("git_sync_status"),
        "terminal_result_valid": result.get("terminal_result_valid"),
        "result_state": result.get("result_state"),
        "production_touched": result.get(
            "production_touched",
            False,
        ),
        "summary_es": result.get("summary_es"),
    }


def build_mcp_server(
    config: WorkerMcpConfig,
    *,
    token_verifier: TokenVerifier | None = None,
    **settings: Any,
) -> MCPServer:
    global _BACKEND_URL
    _BACKEND_URL = config.backend_url.rstrip("/")

    verifier = token_verifier or EdarsahubTokenVerifier(
        backend_url=config.backend_url,
        resource_url=config.resource_url,
    )

    mcp = MCPServer(
        "EDARSAHUB Universal Worker",
        instructions=(
            "Use submit_objective to send approved semantic objectives to "
            "EDARSAHUB. Use get_job_status to read their canonical status. "
            "No low-level worker actions are exposed."
        ),
        token_verifier=verifier,
        auth=AuthSettings(
            issuer_url=AnyHttpUrl(config.issuer_url),
            resource_server_url=AnyHttpUrl(
                config.resource_url
            ),
            required_scopes=[],
            validate_token_resource=False,
        ),
        **settings,
    )

    mcp.tool(
        name="submit_objective",
        title="Submit EDARSAHUB objective",
        annotations=ToolAnnotations(
            readOnlyHint=False,
            destructiveHint=False,
            idempotentHint=True,
            openWorldHint=False,
        ),
    )(submit_objective_tool)

    mcp.tool(
        name="get_job_status",
        title="Get EDARSAHUB Worker job status",
        annotations=ToolAnnotations(
            readOnlyHint=True,
            destructiveHint=False,
            idempotentHint=True,
            openWorldHint=False,
        ),
    )(get_job_status_tool)

    return mcp


def build_transport_security(
    config: WorkerMcpConfig,
) -> TransportSecuritySettings:
    return TransportSecuritySettings(
        allowed_hosts=list(config.allowed_hosts),
        allowed_origins=list(config.allowed_origins),
    )

def provisional_mutation_payload(

def valid_attestation_payload(
    job_id: str,
    *,
    source_sha: str = DEV_SHA,
    files_changed: list[str] | None = None,
) -> dict:
    return {
        "schema": "edarsahub.test-attestation.v1",
        "job_id": job_id,
        "source_sha": source_sha,
        "tests": "PASS",
        "quality_gate": "PASS",
        "production_touched": False,
        "files_changed": list(files_changed if files_changed is not None else CHANGED_FILES),
        "summary_es": "Atestacion SHA-bound verificada.",
        "generated_at_utc": "2026-11-05T01:04:24Z",
    }


def published_certified_payload(
    job_id: str,
    *,
    development_sha: str = DEV_SHA,
    files_changed: list[str] | None = None,
) -> dict:
    return {
        **provisional_mutation_payload(
            job_id,
            development_sha=development_sha,
            files_changed=files_changed,
        ),
        "certification": "CERTIFIED",
        "work_completion": "COMPLETE",
        "percent_complete": 100,
        "certified_source_sha": development_sha,
        "converged_head": development_sha,
        "certification_basis": "SHA_BOUND_ATTESTATION_PLUS_ARTIFACT_CONVERGENCE",
    }


def _setup_queue_state(tmp_path: Path) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path, Path, Path]:
    state = tmp_path / "universal-worker-queue"
    results = state / "results"
    published = state / "published"
    published_results = state / "published_results"
    attestations = (
        tmp_path
        / "mirror-sync"
        / "reporting"
        / "test_attestations"
    )
    for directory in (results, published, published_results, attestations):
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return state, results, published, published_results, attestations

def test_certified_mutation_result_reconciles_from_marker_attestation_and_published_blob(
    tmp_path,
    monkeypatch,
):
    job = "JOB-CERTIFIED-100"
    state, results, published, published_results, attestations = _setup_queue_state(
        tmp_path
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(service, "STATE_ROOT", state)

    local_raw = (
        json.dumps(provisional_mutation_payload(job), indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        + "\n"
    ).encode("utf-8")
    (results / f"{job}.json").write_bytes(local_raw)

    att_raw = (
        json.dumps(valid_attestation_payload(job), indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        + "\n"
    ).encode("utf-8")
    (attestations / f"{DEV_SHA}.json").write_bytes(att_raw)

    pub_raw = (
        json.dumps(published_certified_payload(job), indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        + "\n"
    ).encode("utf-8")
    (published_results / f"{job}.json").write_bytes(pub_raw)

    (published / f"{job}.json").write_text(
        "published=2026-11-05T01:04:24Z\n"
        f"commit={PUB_COMMIT}\n"
        "certification=CERTIFIED\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    status = service.get_job_status(job)
    assert status["lifecycle"] == "RESULT"
    assert status["status"] == "INTEGRATED"
    assert status["certification"] == "CERTIFIED"
    assert status["work_completion"] == "COMPLETE"
    assert status["percent_complete"] == 100
    assert status["quality_gate"] == "PASS"
    assert status["tests"] == "PASS"
    assert status["commit_sha"] == DEV_SHA
    assert status["certified_source_sha"] == DEV_SHA
    assert status["converged_head"] == DEV_SHA
    assert (
        status["certification_basis"]
        == "SHA_BOUND_ATTESTATION_PLUS_ARTIFACT_CONVERGENCE"
    )
    assert status["reconciliation_status"] == "RECONCILED_CERTIFIED"
    assert status["published_result_commit"] == PUB_COMMIT
    assert (
        status["published_result_sha256"]
        == hashlib.sha256(pub_raw).hexdigest()
    )
    assert (
        status["attestation_sha256"]
        == hashlib.sha256(att_raw).hexdigest()
    )
    assert status["result_sha"] == hashlib.sha256(local_raw).hexdigest()
    assert status["terminal_result_valid"] is True
    assert status["production_touched"] is False


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "tamper_kind",
    [
        "missing_attestation",
        "attestation_wrong_sha",
        "attestation_wrong_job_id",
        "attestation_wrong_files",
        "attestation_tests_fail",
        "attestation_production_touched",
        "published_blob_not_certified",
        "published_blob_wrong_sha",
        "local_contradictory_tests_fail",
        "local_contradictory_production_touched",
    ],
)
def test_contradictory_states_fail_closed(
    tmp_path,
    monkeypatch,
    tamper_kind,
):
    job = f"JOB-CONTRADICT-{tamper_kind.upper().replace('_', '-')}"
    state, results, published, published_results, attestations = _setup_queue_state(
        tmp_path
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(service, "STATE_ROOT", state)

    local_payload = provisional_mutation_payload(job)
    att_payload = valid_attestation_payload(job)
    pub_payload = published_certified_payload(job)

    if tamper_kind == "local_contradictory_tests_fail":
        local_payload["certification"] = "CERTIFIED"
        local_payload["tests"] = "FAIL"
    elif tamper_kind == "local_contradictory_production_touched":
        local_payload["certification"] = "CERTIFIED"
        local_payload["production_touched"] = True
    elif tamper_kind == "attestation_wrong_sha":
        att_payload["source_sha"] = "a" * 40
    elif tamper_kind == "attestation_wrong_job_id":
        att_payload["job_id"] = "OTHER-JOB-ID"
    elif tamper_kind == "attestation_wrong_files":
        att_payload["files_changed"] = ["backend/server.py"]
    elif tamper_kind == "attestation_tests_fail":
        att_payload["tests"] = "FAIL"
    elif tamper_kind == "attestation_production_touched":
        att_payload["production_touched"] = True
    elif tamper_kind == "published_blob_not_certified":
        pub_payload["certification"] = "PENDING_AUDIT_EVIDENCE"
        pub_payload["percent_complete"] = 95
    elif tamper_kind == "published_blob_wrong_sha":
        pub_payload["development_sha"] = "b" * 40

    (results / f"{job}.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(local_payload),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    if tamper_kind != "missing_attestation":
        (attestations / f"{DEV_SHA}.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(att_payload),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
    (published_results / f"{job}.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(pub_payload),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (published / f"{job}.json").write_text(
        "published=2026-11-05T01:04:24Z\n"
        f"commit={PUB_COMMIT}\n"
        "certification=CERTIFIED\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    status = service.get_job_status(job)
    assert status["certification"] == "NOT_CERTIFIED"
    assert status["quality_gate"] == "FAIL"
    assert status["tests"] == "FAIL"
    assert status["percent_complete"] == 0
    assert status["terminal_result_valid"] is False
    assert status["blockers"]
